notes.title: Version 16.4
notes.content:
Fixed a ton of script bugs thanks to Salvos on the Steam bug report thread, and one thanks to dudithebudi. Also, box objects of "animal" material no longer pulsate because it looked terrible, like AARFY's floor, but other shapes still do.

Finally, updated troubleshooting info regarding black screen and cursor on start-up, thanks to techno_will. If you see a black screen on startup, try these steps:
	1) Turn off system frame limits.
	2) Change video settings to "High performance Nvidia processor."
	3) Try non-Steam version if all else fails.

Thanks to everyone leaving Steam reviews. 58 more to go and I will shut up about it.

SOURCE:

notes.title: Version 16.0
notes.content:
Fixed the broken Chinese dice minigame by removing the option to cancel Wild #1s and improving AI decision-making. You can still cancel wilds if you call #1 dice on your first turn, and the game will inform you of this. I just refreshed myself on the rules. Apparently it's called Liar's Dice, not Chinese dice. Everybody in China knows how to play it, though. Should I change the minigame name in the next patch?

Possibly also fixed ultra widescreen colored damage flashes (2560x1440). I don't have the hardware to test it, so please tell me if the red damage flashes cover the entire screen.

Also, the character info screen now allows you to examine items, change party orders, and view the overall level of every character, not just the main player. The main player's level is also affected by money and skill points (but not other characters). This new level feature is only for modders who want to allow players to import their characters from other stories and check if they are overpowered, like lots of NWN1 mods.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29239340/df04777509cb813b089d552bf0623abc5d724c64.png[/img]


Working on a couple more things and there should be another patch later this week. Remember to leave a review if you haven't already. I will stop begging for them when I hit 500. Good night people, and remember, everything is computer.


[b]Complete list of changes:[/b]

SOURCE:
-Fixed Chinese Dice AI, Wild #1s can now only be cancelled by picking #1 dice.
-Character info screen now includes option to examine inventory and change party orders.
-Character info screen now displays overall level for all characters, not just main player.
-Possibly fixed colored player damage flashes on 2560x1440 not stretching over entire screen (please test).
-Fixed graphical bug where snow would glitch out every 4 seconds (when weather is set in map script).
-Fixed rare crash when player possessed a rat with Eyes of the Beast and rat died of poison.
-New script boolean: "if_charLvl" to test for current object's overall level score.
-Removed option to turn off auto exam if manually examining object.
-Larger font sizes now have a larger target info window.
-Crosshair arrows are now larger on higher resolutions.

RESOURCES:
-New larger target info window for larger font sizes (top of screen).
-Included snow scripts and textures in the DEFAULT assets folder for modders.
-Updated both manuals.

notes.title: Version 15.6
notes.content:
New script command, "timePass" to... pass the time. Also a new system script called "travel.bsl" that is called every time you travel at the edge of a map, so that time will pass 1 hour (2 in Panama).

Added a button to drop items from the character info screen because somebody asked for something similar on the Warlordocracy Steam page and I forgot what page I was looking at, but it's a good idea for Brigand also.

Had to update the story files, which I hate doing. There were 3 baddies that were the wrong faction, probably because I set them to player while tweaking the maps at some point and forgot that that permanently changes their faction to player. There was a Cyber Knight in Beneath the Ruins map, a Mambo on the Oil Platform in NIGHTMARE, and an Auto-Gun in Arraijan Forest in PANAMA. These were all set to player faction, making the game easier and bringing great shame upon myself.

For difficulty compensation, you are now allowed to train with Carmen and LC in Chapter 2, even though they won't join you in that chapter.

There should be one more patch coming soon, and don't forget the Flooded City modding contest with a $60 prize:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/652410/announcements/detail/551228377603769136


[b]Complete list of changes:[/b]

SOURCE:
-New command: "timePass" to pass given number of ticks (1 tick is 3 seconds).
-New default travel scripts that run whenever player travels at edge of map (travel.bsl).
-Story list no longer reads backup files (.BAK), save list check for .GAM files no longer case sensitive.
-Added a drop item button in character info screen.

SCRIPTS:
-New travel script that passes 1 hour when you travel at map edge (2 hours in PANAMA).
-Carmen and Laughing Coyote will now train you in Chapter 2 (even though they refuse to join party).
-(NIGHTMARE) Queen and Neuro Demons now spawn after talking to Anomaly in Shrouded Cove in NIGHTMARE.
-(NIGHTMARE) Merc, thug, and worker AI scripts can now throw plates in NIGHTMARE.

RESOURCES:

STORY FILES: (requires starting a new game)
-Fixed Cyber Knight faction in Beneath the Ruins map.
-Fixed Kalfu Mambo and Pirate factions on Oil Platform map.
-Disabled Androids are now usable, informing player to use Terminal.
-Changed single "Eleggua Pirate" in Lonely Coast to "Kalfu Pirate" (like the rest).
-(PANAMA) Fixed neutral Auto-Gun C in Arraijan Forest in PANAMA, setting faction to Ronin.

notes.title: Flooded City Mod Contest ($60 Prize)
notes.content:
[u]New Mod Contest (Deadline 1 March 2025)[/u]:

Make a map set in a flooded city, with an objective that is underwater.

First place gets $60, second place gets $30, and third place gets some Steam keys. Deadline is 1 March 2025. You can email your mod to me, or upload it to itch.io. Check out the MOD TUTOR story in the free EXTRAS DLC, the tutorial videos on Youtube, and the Brigand Builder's Manual.

A map set in Shanghai in the Brigand universe would be ideal, as the city is mentioned in the game as being underwater, and a Chinese translation is underway. Shanghai means "up/above the sea", so you can call the map Xiahai, or "down/below the sea". Shanghai is just a suggestion. You can set the map in any flooded city with an objective that is underwater.

Also, there's a relatively new command that nobody has used yet that makes the water level transparent from the surface, called "waterGhost=1". Should be called in the map script because it doesn't save. You can try it out for this mod if you want.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29239340/abbcd7529e1a7a426089031fa4812a40bb8b538a.png[/img]


Also, time to celebrate the bubbles animation getting fixed.

* * *

Meanwhile, there's been a minor Brigand patch to fix a rare bug with doors starting out open, and more. It also seems like the latest version of Steam Proton works with Brigand on Linux Mint and Steam Deck, so no need to use v8.0-5 anymore. Lemme know if you can confirm that.

[u]Complete list of Changes[/u]:

-Fixed rare game-breaking bug where doors would sometimes start in open position (including important locked ones).
-Fixed object angle pivot when importing a player, from new feature in previous patch.
-Added notice to Launcher to use min HUD mode on Steam Deck.

* * *

[u]Future Plans for Brigand[/u]:

-Chinese Translation.
-More mod contests (once every 3 months or so).
-More script commands and editor features for modders (open to suggestions).

* * *

[u]Blog Article[/u]:

Also wrote a new blog article about Linux and why everyone at Microsoft should be fired:

https://blancaster45.blogspot.com/2025/01/for-profit-office-software-must-die_18.html

notes.title: Version 14.6
notes.content:
Here's another update for record-keeping purposes. Mostly so Trollface can see it for the Russian translation. I thought I was done fixing bugs, but you beautiful assholes keep the reports coming.

Fixed bug: If you went to the Scumlands and talked to Lilly, then went through the Topo Tracks and pass, fought off Tio, and then talk to Tio outside the Warehouses, his pathfinding would get fucked up. It was based on the Lilly conversation variable. It is now based on Tio's X position (<3600). I changed the tioUse.bsl and tioAI.bsl files (one "if" line in each).

Also added d3d9.dll to the game's folder, which probably fixes the black screen issue a couple people reported a while back. Thanks to Intoxicated Hyena and felix on Discord. Final patch of all time.

notes.title: Version 5.6 + Hi-Res Skin Patch
notes.content:
This Brigand update fixes a couple AI issues. There was a problem with AI using med kits because the targeting was optional, so now they can use them (on themselves). Also, AI used to run up steep rocks and if they were killed their corpse would be stuck in the air, which just looked ugly. That's been fixed for the most part. Also fixed a bug where the big splash sound was almost inaudible and clarified some dialogue. You can look at the complete list of fixes in the text file.

The stable version of Panama will be out in mid-October, hopefully with voice acting, Steam achievements, and minimal bugs.

For now I want to direct your attention to some user-made content thanks to Jack Mangano (twitter.com/Jack_Mangano). It's a patch that increases and improves the resolution for all character skins, which you can download from the itch.io page for now. I'll put it up on Steam when Panama comes out and I figure out how to upload extra content.

If you want the new character skins or the Panama Beta, here is the link for itch.io: https://blancaster45.itch.io/

notes.title: New Patch on Friday (or Saturday)
notes.content:
There are some new bug reports (and some old complaints) that I'll try to fix before Saturday. There are probably some new script problems that arose after I changed the assets folder system for modability.

Also there are some slowdown and crashing issues on some computers. The low FPS and crashing problems are unrelated, but I'll work on both of them.

EDIT: The game will crash on some computers if you load too many maps (and hence images) in one play session without quitting. So the temporary solution is to quit and reopen the game after you save to prevent crashes. Most computers don't have this problem, but I'll try to fix it in the next patch (or the one after).

notes.content:
Fixed a bug where the player wouldn't automatically obtain coins from corpses if there's another item sitting on top of it, so now it should be easier to make some more money. Also, I deleted a lot more duplicate assets. The total file size is down to under 800 megs now. Lots of other little fixes, so look at the Updates txt for a complete list, as always.

I've started working on the Panama DLC. I've made a few new character skins and I have a bunch of new objects, but I don't wanna give anything away this early. It will still be a couple of months before it's finished.

notes.title: Update in 2 Weeks, Maybe?
notes.content:
There are still about 4 bugs left that need to be fixed, but they are so rare that recreating them is difficult, and I still don't know why they happen: hidden limbs on characters sometimes appear again (like helmets and AKs), sometimes items are dropped that you can't pick up (like rockets, again very rare), and sometimes doors look open but they are actually closed (actually I have never been able to recreate this bug, but I see it happen on Alex's Youtube).

Anyway, I admit that I have started working on a new project. She is slightly younger and sexier, and she likes to drink, and she is 2D. Damn, 2D is easy after this 3D project. It's gonna be like Baldur's Gate, where you can pause with the space bar and give orders to your party, but the graphics will be tile-based in the style of SNES JRPGs. I believe the proper word is 0 degree orthographic projection. It's easy as hell to make art for it and mod it. 

Anyway, Brigand v2.9 in a couple weeks. Then maybe 2.9B. I cannot predict the future after that.

EDIT: I feel like I don't wanna go to v3.0 without a major overhaul, and I'm not sure what that will be yet. Don't worry, saved games will always be compatible with future versions.

notes.title: Next Update in 10 Days
notes.content:
I am taking a short break from programming, but shit, I'm still thinking about it. There are still a couple minor bugs that need to be fixed, some dialogue and AI that need to be improved, and as always I am open to suggestions (except for allowing save scumming, SAVE POINTS FOR LIFE!!!).

I was thinking about how easy it would be for me to make AI characters pick up items on the ground on their own, so if you leave a gun lying around, someone will see it and come pick it up. This would make it so that you need to stash your stuff in a house. Let me know what you think. I would just add a few lines in the AI scripts.

(EDIT: No, nevermind. The player has to drop stuff to organize inventory and then a guard would just come snatch it, haha, damn it. Otherwise it would have been a good idea.)

(EDIT #2: Also, I may have a way to make the game work in Linux WINE, but I'm too lazy to try it unless some people specifically ask for it. Also, you have to help me test it. So let me know.)

notes.title: Update Next Week
notes.content:
I'm gonna release another update soon and then take a break for a while. There will be a 1600x900 resolution option, a couple more save points, and possibly some aesthetic improvements.

Also, I need to make enemy lasers a little less powerful for baddies only somehow. I am thinking that I will make it impossible for baddies to recharge lasers once they run out, forcing them to run up close with katanas and throwing glaives.

Hopefully I can fix the occasional slow-down bug in Loma Larga this time, we'll see.

Other suggestions or bug reports are welcome.
